sql: WITH s AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, at, program_row_id FROM incentive_market_snapshots WHERE at > now() - interval '3 hours' AND book_valid ORDER BY market_ticker, at DESC) SELECT count(*) AS latest_snaps, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.id IS NOT NULL) AS row_join_found, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.end_date > now()) AS row_join_live, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.superseded_at IS NOT NULL) AS row_superseded, count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM incentive_programs c WHERE c.market_ticker = s.market_ticker AND c.superseded_at IS NULL AND c.disappeared_at IS NULL AND c.end_date > now() AND coalesce(c.incentive_type,'') ILIKE '%liquid%')) AS ticker_join_live FROM s LEFT JOIN incentive_programs p ON p.id = s.program_row_id
